    esearch

    esearch.Rd

    search NCBI db using esearch API. retun

    esearch(
  query,
  db = "pubmed",
  api_key = Sys.getenv("NCBI_API_KEY"),
  usehistory = TRUE,
  retmax = 20,
  retstart = 0,
  rettype = "uilist"
)

    Arguments

    query

    NCBI string query. for more information please read

    db

    NCBI DBs described in details

    api_key

    NCBI api_key. you can get your own api_key from NCBI setting page after log-in. To use the function easily, you need to declare "NCBI_API_KEY" in .Renviron file.

    usehistory

    T/F. save result in your search history. you can also get WebEnv information. (default=T)

    retmax

    total number of unique identifiers from the retrived set to be shown in the output (default=20)

    retstart

    number of skipping from the search (Default=0)

    rettype

    (optional) "uilist" or "count" (default="uilist"). if the value is count, the function only redirects the total number of query results.

    datetype

    (optional) one from c("crdt","edat","pdat","mhda")

    Value

    list or vector object.

    Details

    available DBs :

    • https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK25497/table/chapter2.T._entrez_unique_identifiers_ui/?report=objectonly

    • or use the function einfo()

    Followings are examples of search field tags from https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/help/#proximity-searching. You may also get the information by einfo(db="pubmed")$Field

    Affiliation adAll Fields allArticle Identifier aid
    Author auAuthor Identifier auidLast Author Name lastau
    PMID pmidTitle/Abstract tiabGrant Number gr
    Publication Date dpTitle tiMeSH Terms mh
    Text Words twTitle tiMeSH Major Topic majr
